mapper.sql: id, parent_id, menu_type, menu_name, name_i18n, route_name, route_path, component_path, permission_code, icon, sort_no, visible, status, is_external, is_cache, remark, assign_scope, product_code, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM sys_menu
ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_menu
ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_type, menu_name, name_i18n, route_name, route_path, component_path, permission_code, icon, sort_no, visible, status, is_external, is_cache, remark, assign_scope, product_code, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{menuName}, #{nameI18n}, #{routeName}, #{routePath}, #{componentPath}, #{permissionCode}, #{icon}, #{sortNo}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{isExternal}, #{isCache}, #{remark}, #{assignScope}, #{productCode}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT permission_code FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND permission_code IS NOT NULL AND permission_code != '' AND id IN #{menuId} ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT DISTINCT permission_code FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND permission_code IS NOT NULL AND permission_code != '' ORDER BY permission_code

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission_code FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = '0' AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND m.permission_code != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = '0' AND p.assign_scope = 'PLATFORM' AND m.assign_scope = 'TENANT' AND p.parent_id = m.parent_id AND p.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND p.permission_code != '' AND p.permission_code = m.permission_code ) ORDER BY m.permission_code

SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND ( (menu_type = 'M' AND visible = '0') OR (menu_type = 'C' AND component_path IS NOT NULL AND component_path != '') ) ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND product_code = #{productCode} AND ( (menu_type = 'M' AND visible = '0') OR (menu_type = 'C' AND component_path IS NOT NULL AND component_path != '') ) ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT product_code FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND product_code IS NOT NULL AND product_code != '' AND id IN #{menuId}
SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT m.id FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = '0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = '0' AND p.assign_scope = 'PLATFORM' AND m.assign_scope = 'TENANT' AND p.parent_id = m.parent_id AND p.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND p.permission_code != '' AND p.permission_code = m.permission_code ) ORDER BY m.sort_no ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT assign_scope FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT permission_code FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND assign_scope = #{assignScope} AND permission_code IS NOT NULL AND permission_code != '' ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND product_code = #{productCode}
